links.quote: Claude achieved significantly higher diagnostic accuracy than Gemini (92.0% vs. 86.0%, p = 0.012), stronger agreement with the reference standard (κ = 0.893 vs. 0.813), and superior discrimination (macro-AUC 0.998 vs. 0.965).
